first_pass_defects.observed: The focused suite could not be imported under an isolated interpreter (python3 -I), because -I drops the script directory from sys.path and the suite imports its two sibling modules.
first_pass_defects.impact: A clean-runtime invocation matching the seeded CI shape would have failed, which would have undermined the clean-clone recurrence requirement.
first_pass_defects.repair: The test module now inserts its own resolved directory into sys.path before importing its siblings.
first_pass_defects.verification: The suite now passes under python3 -m unittest, direct execution, and isolated CI-shaped discover. It remains impossible to run as python3 -I -m unittest <module-name> from the module's own directory, because under -I unittest cannot import a module by name from a path it has removed; the supported invocations are recorded above instead of claiming otherwise.
